sources.snippet: About This is an abliterated (uncensored) version of Qwen3.5-9B with refusal behavior significantly reduced using 3 iterative passes of orthogonal projection from Arditi et al., 2024. Abliteration rate: 72% (13/18 test prompts answered vs 0/18 for base model) 170 harmful + 160 harmless prompts across 12 refusal categories 64 weight matrices modified per pass across all 32 layers See the full ...

sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.5-9B-abliterated-GGUF is a GGUF distribution of a 9-billion-parameter Qwen3.5 model whose refusal behavior was removed through orthogonal projection and QLoRA fine-tuning. It is maintained by lukey03.
